The guidelines are the course's how-to references. Each one covers a single
piece of the work -- writing a client email, coding open-ended responses,
formatting a graph -- and each is linked from the
[assignment](../assignments/index.qmd) where you first need it.

Unlike assignments, guidelines are not due on any date. Come back to them
whenever you need them; several apply to more than one assignment, and most
apply again to the [Final Report](../assignments/14-final-report.qmd).

## Working with your client

| Guideline | What it covers |
|-----------|----------------|
| [Client Email](client-email.qmd)                       | Writing your first email to your client |
| [Initial Client Meeting](initial-client-meeting.qmd)   | Preparing for and running your first meeting |
| [Contract and Timeline](contract-and-timeline.qmd)     | Filling out the contract and timeline together |
| [Second Client Meeting](second-client-meeting.qmd)     | Setting your research questions |
